# CANDIDATE: VIX_FILTER_FOR_PUTS_ABOVE_15

**Filed:** 2026-09-10  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Adding a VIX filter for put entries in BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON: only allow put entries when VIX >= 15. This avoids entering in low-VIX conditions where put premiums are thin and moves fizzle, potentially reducing losses on marginal winner days and improving edge capture.

## Mechanism

Modify the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup's context filters to include a VIX >= 15 requirement for put entries. This is a pre-entry filter that fires before the trigger evaluation.
